Khuri, Jaisalmer: dunes, desert camps and safari planning

Compare a Khuri desert stay with Sam, plan a dune visit and check camp facilities, safari inclusions and transfers before booking.

Open the tourist map ↗

What makes it worth visiting

A calmer alternative to Sam — smaller crowds, traditional mud-and-thatch houses, and dunes right at the edge of the village.

What to look for

  • Traditional Rajasthani mud houses
  • Smaller, quieter sand dunes
  • Village life away from the main tourist strip

When to go

Overnight, if you want a desert camp experience with fewer crowds than Sam.

Getting there

Southwest of Jaisalmer. Khuri and Sam are separate destinations; confirm the exact camp location before arranging a transfer.

~50 minutes by taxi from the fort.

Khuri or Sam?

Choose the particular stay and outing rather than relying on the village name alone. Sam is the main safari hub in this guide; Khuri offers a village-based alternative. Ask each camp about nearby music, group activities and the dune route if a quieter visit matters to you.

Plan your safari

Explore camel safari details and local options. Confirm that the operator actually serves Khuri, where the ride starts, how long you ride and whether transport from Jaisalmer is included. Do not assume that a Sam listing includes a Khuri transfer.

Before booking a camp

  • Ask for the exact location and a written total for your dates and group.
  • Confirm the tent or room, bathroom arrangement, bedding and meals.
  • Check which rides or performances are included and which cost extra.
  • Agree pickup, return transport, cancellation terms and the booking contact.

Visitor tips

Ask your camp or driver in advance about facilities — facilities vary by property. The Rajasthan Tourism guide lists camel safaris at Khuri and Sam. Checked 21 November 2026; confirm current services directly with the provider.
